thread:
Renee: Flagging INV-9002 — vendor reported they were charged list rates for the beta-enterprise cohort instead of the negotiated vendor rate. Invoice shows $5,400 vs expected $4,320.
Sam: Which vendor and which negotiated rate was supposed to apply? Did the new sheet replace the vendor mapping?
Renee: VendorOps says the vendor was on a 20% off list agreement (VEND-44). We rolled price_v3 earlier this week and I think the vendor mapping was omitted from the CSV.
Victor: Oof. That will require a credit and a manifest fix. Any chance usage spiked?
Renee: Usage looks flat. Delta exactly equals the 20% discount across usage lines.
Aisha: Policy: one-off credits < $1k can be done by billing ops; > $1k needs controller approval. This delta is $1,080 so controller ok needed. Tagging @Sam for approval.
Sam: I approve controller sign-off for the credit. Please include a concise rationale for the ledger entry (vendor rate agreement missing in price upload).
Renee: Proposed action plan:
1) Create credit for $1,080 against INV-9002 (ledger memo: "VEND-44 negotiated discount backfill").
2) Re-upload price manifest including vendor mapping and run a dry reconcile on sample invoices (dry-run).
3) Notify vendor and send corrected invoice + credit note.
Commands I will run (dry-run first):
```
billing-cli prices upload --manifest gs://redwood-prod/manifests/2026-03-20-beta-enterprise.csv --dry-run
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9002 --dry-run
billing-cli credits create --invoice INV-9002 --amount 1080 --reason "vendor negotiated rate backfill" --dry-run
```
Victor: Leave a 45m hold so VendorOps can confirm contact details.
VendorOps: Confirmed vendor contact and PO. They want a corrected invoice and a short note. We'll need the credit applied before we send the corrected invoice PDF.
BillingBot: INV-9002 generated 2026-03-20 15:02 UTC, status: paid. Credit entries will create negative line items when applied; ensure tickets reference FIN-2410.
Aisha: I'll open a controller approval ticket and attach the audit lines. FIN-2410 created.
Sam: Once credit is queued, schedule a replacement invoice generation and have VendorOps confirm receipt. Also add a rollout checklist item: "include vendor_mappings column in price manifest".
Renee: Will do. Assigning postmortem to Victor + Aisha to update rollout playbook.
VendorOps: We'll draft vendor-facing language: short apology, explanation that negotiated rates were not applied due to manifest omission, credit applied. Send draft to Renee for signoff.
Renee: Thanks all. I'll run the dry-runs after 45m hold then remove --dry-run and apply once FIN-2410 is approved. :white_check_mark:
